# R07 — accepted nave and west crossing reservations

The user accepted the R06 800×320 N9/N10 exception. This bounded assembly registers R05's regular nave proxies against R06's crossing-centred junction, replaces the old terminal 640 reservations with 800 reservations, and mirrors the northwest corner and north T1 clear reference to the southwest/south. Profiles remain excluded.

The R05 translation is X−42509, derived by matching the N9 main east clear face. All seven overlapping N9 reference rectangles match exactly (one main and six lower); they are deduplicated. Only new experimental proxy coordinates are registered. No original saved cathedral geometry is translated or overwritten. The unchanged crossing clear square stays at X/Y±2933.

126 clear reservations are included: 104 from N2–N9; N10 and crossing; north/south T1 references; nine cells in each of the two western corner matrices. Every rectangle is a rigid copy of its accepted parent, preserving dimensions. Masonry envelopes have zero positive-area intrusion into these clear spaces. The geometry is valid and IDs are unique. Shared source-coordinate agreement is a local geometric join check, not evidence of physical bearing, historical authenticity or structural adequacy.

The two 800 reservations now record an accepted space-allocation choice. Other supports retain the previous 320 ordinary and 640×320 major allowances. Outer respond 250 and perimeter wall 320 are retained working assumptions. The drawing does not close the exterior wall around the crossing or transept junction; the regular nave wall ends remain an unresolved interface.

Eastern crossing corners, choir, full transept T2 arms, N1 westwork, exceptional chapel attachments and exterior buttress coordination are not integrated. No overall cathedral extent is claimed. F5ZK-C/F5ZN-A, saved ambulatory vaults, working generators, Pass 6J and V13 originals remain protected; F5ZL-C support schedule remains unresolved.

Only existing R05/R06 checkpoints were reused; no new archive search or profile reads. Governance was recovered earlier in this ongoing workflow. INPUTS.json bundles the exact parent checkpoint data for reproduction with `python build_assembly.py` (matplotlib, shapely). All coordinates are native numerical 1:1; physical metre conversion is unresolved. CHECKPOINT.json contains exact polygon geometry and the QA record. The PNG is visually inspected before delivery.

Next: the eastern crossing corners and Q1 choir approach, using the actual junction topology and retaining all approved chevet dimensions. Pause at any discrepancy in choir width/taper authority before propagating the enlarged grid eastward.
